newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia premier appoints acting justice minister.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia premier appoints acting justice minister.

text.p: Ethiopian Prime Minister Meles Zenawi appointed Worede-Wold Wolde as acting minister of justice, replacing Mahetem Solomon who resigned to join private practice, state television reported.
The television reported the appointment hours after Mahetem's resignation on Monday.
Mesfin Girma, former chief prosecutor was appointed vice justice minister, the television added.
